scores.tell: Tick marks and hands are a bit crisp and graphic, but no outlines; rim edge is soft and smooth like real cards.
Soft rounded hat edges with no outline. Brim rim highlight and the stripe ray background are slightly sharper than real cards.
Dark blue anchor has sharp rim lights along the flukes and arms. The rope has many fine strands, so the edge density is higher than on real cards.
Hands and ticks are thin and crisp. Rim and background stripes are clean. Slightly more internal line detail than real cards.
Many crisp small edges: glass rim, ice facets, umbrella scallops, and bright specular streaks. Background diamond pattern lines add more edges than real cards.
Painterly soft edges with no outlines. Fin ridges and spots are soft. Subject edge density is a little lower and softer than the real glossy cards.
Sand grain texture adds a lot of fine edges in the background. Panel boundaries are crisp, and the ball edge is hard.
Locker louvers and door seams are crisp and precise. The edge density in the books and shoes is high, but there is no outline.
Soft edges and a clean rim, almost the same as c119. The hands and ticks are sharp and graphic, which is a small tell.
Smooth rounded forms with no outline. The rope twist edges are a bit crisp, and the dark rim shading at the flukes is a small tell.
